name: WWE Friday Night SmackDown
overview: The superstars of World Wrestling Entertainment's "SmackDown" brand collide each and every Friday on WWE Friday Night SmackDown.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: 1999 season of WWE SmackDown

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: 2000 season of WWE SmackDown

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In 2001, SmackDown is one of the prominent battlegrounds in the war between WWE and the WCW/ECW Alliance. Watch as Superstars like The Rock, Kurt Angle and more defend SmackDown from the WCW/ECW invaders.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: It's a new era on SmackDown as 2002 brings not only the Brand Extension Draft and its SmackDown-exclusive roster of Superstars, but also the debuts of Superstars like John Cena, Batista and more.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Chaos reigns as Brock Lesnar wreaks havoc on the entire SmackDown locker room. Plus, WWE travels to Iraq for the first-ever Tribute to the Troops event. All this and more in the 2003 season of SmackDown.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: SmackDown is home to some of the most head rivalries in all of WWE in 2004, including John Cena vs. John "Bradshaw" Layfield, Kurt Angle vs. Eddie Guerrero, and Brock Lesnar vs. Goldberg.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: The champ is here as John Cena reigns over SmackDown as WWE Champion throughout 2005. The WWE Universe celebrates the life and career of Eddie Guerrero. All this and more in this season of SmackDown.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: The 2006 season of SmackDown celebrates a new King of the Ring as Booker T is crowned and battles Batista. Plus, The Great Khali arrives in WWE and immediately challenges the Undertaker. All this and more.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: 2007 is the year of the Rated-R Superstar as Edge dominates the blue brand by becoming World Heavyweight Champion and forming an alliance (and maybe more) with General Manager Vickie Guerrero. All this and more.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: SmackDown General Manager Vickie Guerrero and Edge continue to build their empire during the 2008 season. But the game is changed when Triple H is drafted to the blue brand and shows why he is the King of Kings.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: As SmackDown celebrates its first decade, the Undertaker shows why he has been among the most dominant Superstars in WWE history. CM Punk forms a new Society while the Hart Dynasty looks to prove it's the best.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: The Straight Edge Society continues to recruit new members. The Nexus rises. The Superstars of Raw and SmackDown look for Bragging Rights. All this and more in the 2010 season of Smackdown.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: Christian, Mark Henry, Daniel Bryan, and Dolph Ziggler headline the 2011 season of SmackDown. Edge retires from in-ring competition, but continues to stir things up by way of his talk show the Cutting Edge.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: Don't miss a moment of the 2012 season of SmackDown, featuring WWE Superstars such as Daniel Bryan, Kane, Big Show, and more. Plus, what does General Manager John Laurinaitis have in store for the Superstars?

seasons.name: Season 15
seasons.overview: It's faction warfare as The Shield, They Wyatt Family, The League of Nations, The Real Americans, and more make their mark on SmackDown. Plus, SmackDown surpasses 700 episodes, all during the 2013 season.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview: The Superstars like Roman Reigns, Rusev, and more take to the ring to show off their incredible skill and ability. Plus, as part of the 2014 season, don't miss SmackDown's pre- and post-shows on WWE Network

seasons.name: Season 17
seasons.overview: As The Authority assumes control of SmackDown in 2015, WWE Superstars like John Cena, Daniel Bryan, Dean Ambrose, and more fight back. Plus, The New Day makes themselves at home on the blue brand.

seasons.name: Season 18
seasons.overview: The 2016 WWE Draft changes the course of the blue brand forever as it becomes SmackDown LIVE with its exclusive Superstars, its own Tag Team and Women's Championships, and the home of the WWE Championship.

seasons.name: Season 19
seasons.overview: While Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn make life miserable for Commissioner Shane McMahon and General Manager Daniel Bryan, The Riott Squad, Bobby Roode, Shinsuke Nakamura, and more make the blue brand home in 2017

seasons.name: Season 20
seasons.overview: Becky Lynch becomes The Man. Daniel Bryan returns to the ring. Paige steps into a new role as General Manager. The New Day joins the Five-Timers' Club. All this and more during SmackDown's 2018 season.

seasons.name: Season 21
seasons.overview: In 2019, SmackDown LIVE continues to change the game in sports-entertainment. As the McMahon Family retakes control of the blue brand, intense rivalries like Daniel Bryan vs. Kofi Kingston take center stage.
